summary:
美滿電子EPS符合預期，營收年增27.6%顯示AI客製化晶片（ASIC）需求帶動成長。
• EPS 0.80美元，與預期0.79美元接近，超預期幅度0.64%
• 營收24.2億美元，年增27.57%，AI與資料中心需求強勁
• 客製化晶片（ASIC）與光通訊產品為核心成長引擎
• 資料中心營收占比提升優化產品組合
ai_view:
訊號偏正：EPS雖僅符合預期，但營收年增近28%才是重點，顯示AI客製化晶片與資料中心需求強勁帶動成長。短期股價對「營收強、EPS平」可能呈現拉鋸，市場聚焦利潤率擴張。中期核心在AI ASIC設計案放量與資料中心營收占比。追蹤指標：資料中心營收年增、ASIC設計案進度、毛利率、客戶集中度與全年指引。

需留意：本益比104倍偏高，估值已反映AI成長預期；EPS僅持平，利潤率擴張速度待觀察；客戶集中與AI資本支出循環波動風險

summary_en:
Marvell met EPS expectations with 27.6% revenue growth, as AI custom-silicon (ASIC) demand drives the top line.
• EPS of $0.80 came in near the $0.79 estimate, a 0.64% beat
• Revenue of $2.42B grew 27.57%, with strong AI and data-center demand
• Custom silicon (ASIC) and optical-connectivity products are core growth engines
• A rising data-center revenue mix improves the product portfolio

ai_view_en:
Signal is positive: EPS was only in line, but the ~28% revenue growth is the real story, showing strong AI custom-silicon and data-center demand. Near-term the stock may seesaw on 'strong revenue, flat EPS,' with the market focused on margin expansion. Mid-term the core is AI ASIC design-win ramp and data-center revenue mix. Track: data-center revenue growth, ASIC design-win progress, gross margin, customer concentration and full-year guidance.

Watch：A 104x P/E is elevated, already pricing in AI growth expectations; EPS merely in line, so margin-expansion pace bears watching; Customer concentration and AI-capex cycle volatility risk
beat_or_miss: 符合預期 / EPS僅超預期0.64%基本持平，惟營收年增27.57%動能強。
